NORAD ID: 37179
Int'l Code: 2010-051A
Launch date: October 6, 2010
Source: People's Republic of China (PRC)
Launch site: Taiyaun Space Center, China (TSC)

SJ-6G (SHIJIAN-6G) and SJ-6H (SHIJIAN-6H) are the fourth pair of Shijian 6 satellites. The spacecraft, will probe the space environment, according to Xinhua. Shijian satellites are believed to test technology demonstration and space research experiments. Shijian means "practice" in Chinese.
